extracted.intended_audience: Researchers/authors preparing submissions to the Kyoto Journal of Mathematics
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for preparing and submitting original research papers and surveys in pure mathematics to the Kyoto Journal of Mathematics, covering required metadata, file formats, LaTeX preferences, submission procedures, and proof-correction policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope / Article types
rubrics_metrics.description: The Kyoto Journal of Mathematics publishes original research papers at the forefront of pure mathematics, including surveys that contribute to advances in pure mathematics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions should be articles on pure mathematics or surveys that contribute to advances in pure mathematics; ensure your work fits this topical/scholarly scope before submitting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Articles on pure mathematics intended for publication in the Kyoto Journal of Mathematics must be written in English.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the paper is written in French or German, include an English translation of the abstract.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality / simultaneous submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Submission of a paper acknowledges that the paper is original and is not submitted elsewhere.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not submit manuscripts that are under consideration at other journals; by submitting you affirm originality and exclusive submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic submission method
rubrics_metrics.description: Electronic versions of the paper in LaTeX and PDF should be submitted by e-mail to kjm@math.kyoto-u.ac.jp.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include all required files in the email submission (see supplemental files criterion). Prefer minimal packages and macros as noted in LaTeX guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preferred LaTeX classes and package policy
rubrics_metrics.description: We prefer that authors using LaTeX use the basic article or amsart classes, with a minimum of extra packages and user macros.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep use of nonstandard packages and custom macros to a minimum to ease processing; the LaTeX source will be needed for final publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hard copy submission procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Hard copy submissions will also be accepted, but the LaTeX source file will be needed for final publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If submitting by hard copy, send two copies of the paper to the Editor, Kyoto Journal of Mathematics, Department of Mathematics, Graduate School of Science, Kyoto University, Kyoto 606-8502, Japan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplemental files to include
rubrics_metrics.description: Please include the following when submitting a paper: All figures, style files, and any other supplemental files needed to process the paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure figures and any nonstandard style files or additional material required to compile and typeset the paper are provided with the submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mathematics Subject Classification numbers
rubrics_metrics.description: 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification numbers. If there are primary and secondary numbers, please indicate them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the appropriate 2010 MSC codes and clearly mark primary vs secondary classifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keywords
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide between three and five keywords describing the subject/content of the paper.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstract length and inclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: An abstract of no more than 300 words. The abstract should be submitted as part of the paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the abstract within the submitted manuscript; for French/German papers also include an English translation of the abstract.

rubrics_metrics.name: Running head requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: A running head (a shortened version of the title) of no more than 50 characters, including spaces.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a concise running head ≤50 characters to be used in the journal header.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proofs and corrections policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Articles published in the Kyoto Journal of Mathematics will be copyedited and typeset by Duke University Press. Authors will have the opportunity to review proofs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Due to the high cost of page proof revisions, corrections should be limited to typographical errors. Expect to receive proofs for review and limit corrections accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial contact information
rubrics_metrics.description: Editorial Office contact details: Department of Mathematics, Graduate School of Science, Kyoto University, Kyoto 606-8502, Japan; kjm@math.kyoto-u.ac.jp
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact the editorial office at kjm@math.kyoto-u.ac.jp for questions about submissions, proofs, or other editorial matters.
